welcome_message: A football tactics game: you draw your tactic on a notebook-style pitch, set roles and instructions per player, then watch the match play out and adjust from the touchline. Early demo, Windows, free.
1. Be decent. No harassment, no slurs, no spam.
2. Keep channels on topic: bugs in #bug-reports, wishes in #ideas, tactics in #tactics.
3. No piracy, no real-club or real-player data files (the game uses fictional clubs on purpose).
4. Tester builds stay inside this server.
5. Moderators can remove messages and members without discussion.

Say what confused you, what was fun and what broke. If something goes wrong in the game, press **F9**: it saves a small zip (screenshot, log, your note) on your desktop that you can attach in #bug-reports. Nothing is sent automatically.
The game is not code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen may warn you. That is expected for a small indie build.
faq_message: **Windows says 'protected your PC'.** The build is not code-signed. Click 'More info' > 'Run anyway' if you trust the download from the itch page.
**Where are my saves?** In `%APPDATA%\Godot\app_userdata\Gaffer's Notebook\` (settings, career, tactics, progress).

**How do I send feedback from the game?** Press F9 (or Feedback in the main menu). It writes `GaffersNotebook-feedback-<date>.zip` on your desktop with a screenshot, the game log and your note; nothing is sent automatically. Attach it in #bug-reports.
**Can I share tactics?** Yes: Library > Export gives a JSON file; post it in #tactics.
**Is the game finished?** No. This is an early demo; levels, AI and content will change between builds.
